prompt_text: tight square editorial crop of two contrasting stacks on a brushed metal surface: one clipped reusable logic packet centered and neat, one blurred discarded snapshot stack pushed aside at the edge; one dominant center-safe focal bundle, tactile industrial materials, no poster feel and no document text. no text in the generated image, no poster layout, no dashboard feel, no weak focal hierarchy, keep the main subject center-safe for 1:1 reuse. Target aspect ratio: 1:1 Critical render rule: do not generate any readable text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, logos, watermarks, slide titles, document copy, dashboard copy, UI text, headline text, wall text, or typographic overlays anywhere in the image. If a screen, board, document, dashboard, scorecard, or interface is visible, it must contain only abstract non-readable blocks, simple shapes, and soft placeholder marks. Never place large title words, marketing slogans, section headers, or composited text for later overlay; leave that area visually quiet and empty instead. Keep the focal object simple, bold, and centered without visible interface copy or poster-like headline treatment.
negative_prompt: copy-paste cartoon, readable document labels, office desk stationery shot, laptop screen, meme-style before/after.
alt_text_en: show one reusable logic packet kept apart from disposable project snapshot material.
caption_en: show one reusable logic packet kept apart from disposable project snapshot material.
